skill.summary: General Motors is transitioning from a legacy automaker to an EV and autonomous driving leader with its Ultium battery platform and Cruise robotics.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the General Motors skill, providing an overview of GM’s history, business model, and EV/autonomous driving transition.
- Includes key historical milestones from 1908 founding to the 2023 Cruise regulatory issues.
- Details on GM’s Ultium battery platform, major vehicle lines, and software/service initiatives.
- Provides moat (competitive advantage) analysis and 2023 financial/key metrics.
- Highlights interesting facts on GM’s industry impact and recovery post-2008 bailout.
